title: Gideon and the Cellar
author: Freya Nystrom
blurb: Ulyana Galloway, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
